unit_statements_verbatim:
# Spatial Studies Minor

---

The Spatial Studies minor requires a minimum of 20 units, consisting of one lower-division elective, three required courses and an upper-division elective.

notes.text: The Spatial Studies minor requires a minimum of 20 units, consisting of one lower-division elective, three required courses and an upper-division elective. The minor offers students an opportunity to examine some of the major challenges of the 21st century (climate change, human health and sustainability, urbanization and cultural homogenization, among others) through a spatial lens.
